prompt: benchmark.mjs prompt, the tasks T1–T7, L1–L10 and N1–N4, and the questions of understanding U1–U5

T5.query: lines | filter ~(contains "ERROR") * (split " ERROR " | last) | distinct | json

L5.query: ::string | spec | /verbs | filter ~(docs | first | content | contains "begins with") | first

N3.query: ::qlang | manifest | filter ~(docs | first | links * print | any ~(contains "::error | docs"))

N4.query: ::vec | spec | /verbs | sort * (docs | first | quotes | count) | sum

understanding: U1–U5 answered in the terms of the pages, accurately: values, kinds and tags as one identity; the walk of a name from the tags through the shape to any value; errors as values opened by !|; the pages as a hypertext of docs with laws and links, read many at once by links * open and manifest * docs.

frictions.got: Git Bash rewrote /data; the prompt's note on MSYS_NO_PATHCONV forgotten mid-session
SpecBindingNotFoundError with :addresses #[] and no nearest name
::Small: a raised map takes the tag its :kind names, so an error is known by its site, never by ::error alone

frictions.expected: a way to declare a kind that checks its values
frictions.got: no page it read shows the declaration of a kind with a constructor, `::T {:impl …}`; the kind was imitated by a verb that tags or raises

frictions.expected: the laws of every verb of vectors summed
frictions.got: 6: * over the set of verbs answers the set of images, so equal counts merge; the listings of the catalog are sets, and a count or a sum over them answers wrong in silence

frictions.expected: a fold by a two-slot quote
frictions.got: ReduceReducerNotBinaryError; the page of reduce does not say its reducer is a verb named by one word
ContainsSubjectNotStringError: source of a link answers its quote; print writes its text
DropCountNotIntegerError, whose name does not point at minus, the friction of R4.F4 met again
